newsitem.title: USA: Compaq sees $120 mln value in contract.
newsitem.headline: Compaq sees $120 mln value in contract.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said Tuesday certain models of its new Deskpro personal computers have been added to the U.S. Air Force Desktop V contract, held by Hughes Electronics Corp affiliate Hughes Data Systems, and the potential value of this contract to Compaq is estimated to be $120 million during the remaining life of Desktop V.

Awarded in May 1996, the three-year Desktop V contract is valued at $924 million and will provide up to 360,000 computers, peripherals, software, and related service and support for Air Force commands, bases and other worldwide users, including federal and civilian agencies.
